activation_note: Never retroactive for delivered episodes: active from E15 (being reworked) onward, or when a manifest declares combat_unit_direction_policy=COMBAT_UNIT_DIRECTION_V1.

rules.CU1: COMBAT_UNIT_CAMERA_LOCKED: a combat unit is not rendered on a locked/tripod camera; the writer's authored move stays
rules.CU2: COMBAT_UNIT_CARRIES_DIALOGUE: a combat unit carries no on-screen spoken line
rules.CU3: COMBAT_UNIT_PROMPT_HOLD_LANGUAGE: a combat unit's prompt carries no hold/settle/tripod wording in its combat beats, its camera line or its closing handoff line (no 'then hold', no 'keep natural micro-motion')
rules.CU4: FIGHT_SCENE_NARRATED: in a scene with combat, combat units are >= 50% of the scene's seconds
rules.CU5: FIGHT_TWO_SHOT_FACING_CAMERA: fighters are never composed with both faces turned to the lens
rules.CU6: COMBAT_UNIT_NO_CONTACT_BEATS: a combat unit carries at most one 'no contact in this beat' beat and such beats are at most one third of its beats; approach/walk-in goes into the wind-up of a contact beat

weapon_lock.rendered: appended to the 'Same look in every frame' line of every unit the character is bound in (h3_provider_prompt_renderer.appearance_anchor_line)
weapon_lock.authority: Roger 2026-11-07 E15 重投复审: VU-019 曲背大刀在 4.7 s 变成直身长剑
